sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fractional CFO Advisory and Multicurrency Ledger Bookkeeping

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law and residual French civil law heritage (former Anglo-French Condominium); statutory interpretation follows common law doctrine
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, provisionally applied from 2020)
Note: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; International Companies are tax-exempt

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020 (Act No. 13 of 2020); International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2018 and 2021 (beneficial ownership and register provisions); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act 1993; Proceeds of Crime Act 2001; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized director and beneficial owner identification package (passport copies, proof of residential address, bank reference)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or licensed certified accountant in the applicant's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; authentication via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs or a Vanuatu honorary/consular post)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate existence and certificate of good standing of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (apostille certificate from an apostille-state registry may be accepted only if the Vanuatu registered agent's internal policy so permits)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed power of attorney authorizing the Vanuatu registered agent to file incorporation documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or notarial certification accepted under the registered agent's CDD policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD under AML/CFT Act 2020: domestic and foreign PEPs receive enhanced due diligence and senior management sign-off; mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, and Australian DFAT listings; registered agent must retain screening evidence for at least 5 years and file suspicious transaction reports to the VFSC within statutory deadlines.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry - International Companies Name Clearance and Filing Portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory naming doctrine: International Company names must be in Latin script (English or French) and must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd'; Arabic numerals and limited punctuation (hyphen, ampersand, comma, period, parentheses) are allowed; any foreign-script trade name must be accompanied by a certified English transliteration for the VFSC file; names must not be misleading, obscene, or contrary to public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On VFSC name refusal, the applicant or its registered agent must file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 calendar days of the refusal notice, stating grounds for reconsideration and providing evidence that the name is neither prohibited nor misleading; the Registrar must issue a determination within 14 working days; a further refusal may be challenged by judicial review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222); in parallel, a substitute name reservation may be filed without penalty; a single 30-day renewal of an approved reservation is available on written request before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptable for service delivery only: an International Company must continuously maintain a statutory registered office at the premises of its VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, where records must be available during business hours; the virtual CFO services and multicurrency ledger bookkeeping may be performed remotely from any jurisdiction; a post-office box address alone does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated below 10% probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection of this no-physical-presence entity within the first 12 months (VFSC risk-based AML/CFT supervision concentrates on licensed registered agents, banks and financial services dealers; statutory inspections are ordinarily exercised at the registered agent's address for a domestic no-substance advisory entity).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and name reservation fee (VFSC)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry fee per VFSC fee tariff for international company name search

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (standard share capital not exceeding VT 10 million)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee under International Companies (Fees) Regulations / VFSC approved tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and statutory registered office - first year inclusive
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a zero-substance international company (USD 600 - 900 per annum)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of Memorandum and Articles of Association, organizational minutes and share register
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Incorporation counsel engaged by the applicant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee at prevailing Vanuatu market rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, consular legalization and English certification of UBO/director identification documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country notary plus Vanuatu consular or Ministry of Foreign Affairs post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial and consular tariffs in the document origin country

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT CDD, PEP and sanctions screening plus UBO register setup (first-year compliance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fee under the registered agent's client acceptance schedule

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (ss. 5 'Incorporation of International Companies', 7 'Registered Office and Registered Agent', 13 'Share Capital', 15 'Articles of Association / Bye-Laws'); Companies Act, Cap. 191 (residual); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act No. 18 of 2020 (AML/CFT obligations); International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 (register of beneficial owners)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry / Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila and Luganville
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company submitted under Section 5 of the International Companies Act, Cap. 222
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; one issued share for each founding subscriber at a nominal value not less than US$1 or equivalent (e.g. one Class A Share at US$1); no escrow or capital deposit requirement exists for an International Company under Cap. 222
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The share subscription to the founder subscriber is confirmed, and one Limited Voting Common Share of US$1.00 nominal value is hereby allotted and issued. FURTHER RESOLVED: The registered office of the Company is established at the office of the Licensed Registered Agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu. FURTHER RESOLVED: [Name] is appointed Director/President, and [Name] is appointed Secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED: The licensed Registered Agent is ratified for maintenance of the statutory registers. FURTHER RESOLVED: The Directors are empowered to execute the Application for Incorporation, pay all statutory fees, open accounts with Stripe and Wise, and effect service contracts. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry via a VFSC-licensed International Company Service Provider (registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a licensed agent; execute an engagement letter including client due diligence; submit two proposed names for VFSC name availability search and reservation; obtain a written name-reservation certificate; secure the registered agent's consent to act as registered office and agent for the IC.
required_dossiers: Two proposed corporate names in English
CDD / KYC pack for each shareholder, director and beneficial owner
Signed registered agent engagement letter
Customer Due Diligence declaration confirming lawful business purpose (virtual CFO and bookkeeping services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected for confusing similarity or undesirability, file an alternate name within 5 business days; appeal a VFSC name refusal in writing to the Registrar under Regulation 6 of the International Companies Regulations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Charter Documents and Incorporation Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (statutory preparer) with subsequent VFSC lodgement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Charter (Memorandum and Articles / Bye-Laws) stating permitted objects (accounting, bookkeeping, outsourced CFO consultancy); complete Form 1; prepare consents of the initial director and secretary; verify the registered office address and agent certificate; arrange electronic or wet-ink execution by the subscriber.
required_dossiers: Completed and signed Form 1 Application for Incorporation
Charter (Memorandum and Articles of Association / Bye-Laws)
Consent to Act as Director
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Copy of strategic business plan / target payment rails declaration (Stripe, Wise)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC returns a defect letter for incomplete disclosures, remedy and resubmit within 21 days; the registered agent may file a corrective statement under Section 8 of the International Companies Act; late correction attracts only the resubmission fee, if any.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Application and Pay Registration Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (Port Vila counter or agent-filed online lodgement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Form 1 with the Charter and consents; pay the USD 500 government registration fee plus applicable stamp duty; obtain a VFSC receipt; track the application in the VFSC workflow; retained supporting CDD materials remain on file with the agent.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form 1 duly notarized where required
Charter and consents
VFSC fee receipt
Registered agent certification of address
Authority-to-transact from the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the VFSC information request within 14 days; where the application is rejected, file a corrective charter amendment or new Form 1 with revised consents without restarting the name reservation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Certificate of Incorporation and Establish Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry / Registered Agent for registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation (IC No.); open the register of members, directors and secretary, charges and beneficial owners; issue share certificate for the allotted share; convene the first board meeting and adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution; retain minutes in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (VFSC-issued)
Register of Members and Share Ledger
Register of Directors and Secretary
Register of Beneficial Owners (under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014)
Minutes of First Board Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical defects, apply to VFSC for a corrected certificate under Section 8(2) of Cap. 222; if registers are lost or damaged, reconstruct them via executive declaration and notify VFSC within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Trade Business Licence and Complete Tax and Foreign Investment Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (Business Licence Unit) under the Ministry of Finance; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for foreign investment approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Business Licence Application Form BL-1 for professional services (accounting / outsourced CFO); file with VIPA a Foreign Investment Approval Certificate if the IC maintains a physical presence or employs expatriate staff; confirm the IC's tax-exempt status as an offshore entity, obtaining a letter of exemption from income tax and noting non-registration for VAT when no domestic revenue is generated.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Business Licence Application Form BL-1
VIPA Foreign Investment Approval Certificate (where physical premises or employees are established)
Details of shareholders, directors and ultimate beneficial owners
Registration deed or lease agreement for the local office
Notarized passports of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licence application is refused due to incomplete VIPA approval, obtain the VIPA certificate first and resubmit; appeal the decision to the Minister of Finance under Section 19 of the Business Licence Act, Cap. 76.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete AML/CFT Onboarding and Activate Payment Rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Unit and financial institution KYB teams (Stripe, Wise, correspondent banks)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the AML/CFT compliance statement and beneficial ownership returns as required for a service provider; appoint a compliance officer and internal AML policy; submit KYB packages to Stripe and Wise referencing the Certificate of Incorporation and business licence; activate multicurrency ledger and payment collection workflows.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Business Licence
Register of Beneficial Owners declaration
Board resolution authorizing account opening and use of Stripe / Wise
AML/CFT Compliance Manual and Risk Assessment
Director passports, proof of address and professional references
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYB is rejected, provide re-verified VFSC registry extract, corporate bank reference, and revised legal opinion; lodge an escalated due-diligence package or select an alternative regulated payment processor within 15 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (Business Licence Unit), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for foreign investor clearance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade and Business Licence, Class: Professional Services (Accounting, Bookkeeping and Outsourced Virtual CFO Services), issued under the Business Licence Act, Cap. 76

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not Listed — the virtual CFO consultancy is a no-facility telework operation; no EIA registration or comprehensive EIA is triggered under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002 and its EIA Regulations because the activity does not appear in the prescribed project schedule and produces no land or marine footprint
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge thresholds apply to digital service operations; where a leased office is established, apply the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act No. 24 of 1994 for e-waste and paper disposal, and maintain electrical safety and generator compliance; zero solid waste to landfill target for office consumables is recommended.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services covering the registered office; structural load and occupancy inspection under the Building Act, Cap. 155 evidencing leased premises compliant for office use; occupational health and safety clearance under the Employment Act, Cap. 160, including remote-work ergonomic assessment, first-aid provisions, and electrical safety inspection; business-continuity and cyclone-risk contingency measures recognised under Vanuatu National Disaster Management Office guidance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (DCIR); official portal: www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; customs declarations processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World single-window; VAT registrations and returns are administered directly at DCIR offices in Port Vila and Luganville, with no separate national VAT e-portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (IC) is issued a DCIR VAT Identification Number, which serves as the operative TIN. Procedure: lodge Form VAT-01 (Application for Registration) with DCIR, accompanied by a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered office and registered agent details, director and beneficial owner KYC records under Vanuatu's AML/CFT legislation, and a projected annual turnover declaration. Compulsory registration arises only when annual taxable local turnover exceeds VUV 5,000,000; a non-resident IC making only zero-rated offshore supplies to non-residents is not required to register, though it may voluntarily register to recover input VAT. DCIR typically issues the VAT ID/TIN within 3–5 business days of receiving a complete application.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu has no income tax or capital gains tax and no check-the-box or comparable entity classification regime. International Companies are treated conclusively as non-resident tax-exempt corporations. Under the VAT Act, the only available elections are (1) voluntary VAT registration below the VUV 5,000,000 compulsory threshold, and (2) the substantive election to characterize eligible cross-border services as zero-rated exports by maintaining the required offshore documentation. No hybrid mismatch elections or statutory hybrid rules are legislated in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 [Cap. 248], administered by DCIR
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover in any rolling 12-month period (compulsory registration threshold); voluntary registration is available below VUV 5,000,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu. VAT-registered businesses are required to issue itemized VAT tax invoices in paper or PDF and file periodic VAT returns with DCIR in paper/PDF. The only mandatory electronic filing window is ASYCUDA World, which is used exclusively for customs export/import declarations. No government API clearance regime applies to VAT invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Value Added Tax Act 1998, Schedule 2, zero-rating applies to: (1) exports of goods physically removed from Vanuatu, evidenced by customs documentation within the prescribed period; and (2) services supplied to a non-resident of Vanuatu where the recipient is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, the services are not directly connected to land or goods situated in Vanuatu, and the benefit is consumed wholly outside Vanuatu. The outsourced Virtual CFO advisory and multicurrency ledger bookkeeping services qualify as zero-rated offshore services where the client is a non-resident, the engagement is performed for an offshore business, and the invoice is paid from offshore bank accounts. The taxpayer must substantiate both the non-resident status of the recipient and the offshore receipt of the consideration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry) for any physical goods or digital media shipped out of Vanuatu, where applicable
Commercial VAT invoice marked 'Zero-Rated Export' showing the nature of the offshore services and the non-resident client's identity
Signed service agreement / statement of work demonstrating that the services are supplied to a non-resident and performed for a business located outside Vanuatu
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for physical exports) evidencing departure from a Vanuatu port
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 payment advice from the offshore-paying bank, showing receipt of funds into the Vanuatu IC's bank account within the substantiation period
Evidence of the client's non-residency, such as a foreign business registration extract, tax residence certificate, or utility bill in the name of the foreign client
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR audits zero-rating claims through verifiable export evidence, including the customer's non-residency, the locus of service performance, and the incoming offshore settlement. Where the 0% rate is not substantiated within the 180-day evidentiary window, DCIR recharacterizes the invoice as a taxable local supply at 15% VAT and assesses the tax together with monthly interest at 2% per month on unpaid tax, late-payment penalties, and additional penalties. Willfully false export claims carry penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or up to five years' imprisonment, and any VAT refunds previously paid in respect of the fraudulent zero-rating are clawed back in full with retrospective effect.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as prudential and AML/CFT regulators; the RBV administers exchange control under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 64] and publishes the official VUV daily reference rates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible on the current account and Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, thereby prohibiting exchange restrictions on current international transactions. Capital-account transactions are broadly liberalised for International Companies: the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] expressly exempts an IC from the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 64]. Profit, dividend and service-fee remittances by a non-resident-owned IC are unrestricted and free of any Vanuatu withholding tax, subject only to bank-level KYC verification of board resolutions, client service agreements and source-of-funds records.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender regime and no mandatory conversion ratio for any entity, resident or exempt. Service-export receipts, including virtual CFO consulting fees, may be retained indefinitely in any foreign currency. For an IC the exemption is absolute: no RBV approval, no surrender timeline, no repatriation obligation and no conversion requirement applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multicurrency Account (VUV/USD/AUD); escrow sub-account available for client-fee collections

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium practical viability with strict legal constraints. Wise (UK FCA-regulated electronic money institution) will onboard a Vanuatu IC remotely for multicurrency collection and disbursement, but it holds no Vanuatu licence and must not be used for VUV-denominated local settlement, which under Vanuatu law requires an RBV-licensed banking or payment institution. Stripe does not support Vanuatu as a merchant market, so Stripe Billing must be fronted by a supported-jurisdiction gateway or by Wise with the IC identified as the underlying beneficiary and daily treasury sweeps into an RBV-licensed domestic bank concentration account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory in-person interview mandate exists under Vanuatu law. In practice, ANZ and BSP require at least one director or appointed signatory to attend a face-to-face KYC interview in Port Vila unless the bank exercises discretion to accept notarised and apostilled copies, a current banker's reference from a reputable overseas bank and a compliance certificate from the IC's VFSC-licensed registered agent. Fully remote onboarding is possible but attracts substantially longer due-diligence review and enhanced documentation conditions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident ownership with remote management and no leased office or substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incumbency and registered-agent confirmation issued under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; board resolution appointing offshore directors and managers; executed client service agreements evidencing genuine economic activity; professional-fee ledger and a nil-liability statement confirming the IC's tax-exempt status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border fee flows inconsistent with a three-person virtual operating model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Published fee schedule; project-management and CRM data exports mapping invoices to named engagements; service-level agreements with payment terms and direction-of-payment clauses; accountant-reviewed financial statements if aggregate throughput exceeds USD 500,000 per annum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owners or major counterparties located in FATF grey-listed or sanctions-affected jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial sanctions and PEP screening output (Refinitiv, Dow Jones or equivalent); independent due-diligence report prepared by a VFSC-licensed trust and company service provider; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations; banker's reference from a top-tier foreign financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Primary settlement conducted through unlicensed fintech rails (Stripe/Wise) rather than an RBV-licensed bank
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Regulatory status certificates for each PSP (e.g., FCA electronic-money licence for Wise); treasury policy mandating daily sweeping of PSP balances into a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank concentration account; contractual segregation of client moneys from the IC's own funds with supporting audit trail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from shareholders or directors are routed by SWIFT MT103 from the remitter's account to the IC's Vanuatu account with the narration 'Share Capital Contribution' or 'Shareholder Loan'. No prior RBV approval is required and no paid-up minimum capital applies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The receiving bank files RBV Balance-of-Payments statistical reports automatically; the IC retains the board resolution, updated shareholder register and executed loan agreement in its compliance file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Service disbursements (subcontractor CFO fees, SaaS licences, platform costs and office expenses) are cleared via SWIFT MT103 across ANZ or BSP correspondent networks, with USD settled through New York correspondents and AUD through Sydney correspondents. Commercial letters of credit are not applicable to ISIC 6920 service exports. VUV conversions are executed at the RBV daily reference rate without exchange-control approval for ICs. Wise is acceptable only for low-value disbursements under USD 10,000 per transaction, with all balances swept daily to the licensed domestic concentration account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable spot and forward FX contracts with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer bank
Non-deliverable VUV forwards referencing the RBV daily mid-rate with approved offshore counterparties
Cross-currency swaps for AUD/USD and EUR/USD revenue streams via the primary relationship bank
Multicurrency natural-hedge netting across operating ledger balances (no derivative instrument required)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (International Company Annual Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the exact anniversary of incorporation; due by that calendar date each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late fee equal to 10% of the annual fee is imposed if payment is not received within 30 days after the anniversary; if the annual fee and late fee remain unpaid for 90 days after the anniversary, the VFSC may administratively strike the International Company off the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation (Unofficial declaration accompanying fee payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), filed by the Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual fee, due on the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain this confirmation triggers immediate escalation to VFSC scrutiny and may result in suspension of the agent's act, restriction of the company's bank services, or eventual strike-off if combined with unpaid fees.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company; exemption applies to all companies within the IC regime, including outsourced virtual CFO and accounting consultancies. No public-interest threshold triggers a mandatory audit for an IC unless it voluntarily opts into the Companies Act regime or is separately licensed as a financial institution (not applicable here).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework for International Companies; as a best-practice voluntary measure, the entity may adopt IFRS or simplified cash-basis local GAAP, but no filing obligation exists with any Vanuatu authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu ICs maintain a confidential beneficial ownership register at the registered agent. There is no public annual UBO filing; however, the Registered Agent must obtain an annual written confirmation (or acknowledgement of no change) from the company secretary covering shareholder transfers, percentage ownership, and ultimate beneficial owners. Any share transfer during the year must be accompanied by a directors’ resolution and a refreshed share certificate register. This annual confirmation remains private and is not filed with the VFSC.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (held by Registered Agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – 1,000 for registered office and registered agent combined, depending on service level
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (exempt from statutory audit); voluntary certified audit typically USD 2,500 – 7,500 for a virtual CFO consultancy with multicurrency ledgers

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (zero-tax territory; Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no undistributed profits tax on International Companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No CIT statute exists. International Companies are contractually exempt from all present and future Vanuatu taxes on international business income under Section 75 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The only recurring fiscal burden is the annual VFSC license/registration fee administered by the registered agent. Outbound digital CFO services to non-resident clients qualify for zero-rated treatment under the 12.5% VAT Act [Cap 247], resulting in a practical effective cash tax rate of 0% on genuine offshore service revenue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The mandatory compliance instrument is the Annual Return of an International Company, filed through the licensed registered agent via the VFSC ePortal under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return due within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary; the annual VFSC license fee is payable on or before the anniversary date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name exactly as per Certificate of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert Latin-script legal name; confirm no domestic trading name is used in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC registration number of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Format IC-XXXXX; cross-check against the Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC verification letter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office physical address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the registered agent's licensed office; a PO Box alone is non-compliant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name and license number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Agent must hold a current VFSC international company service provider license.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors' full names, residential addresses, identity documents, and beneficial ownership declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; collect and file BO data with the agent under the VFSC AML Rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders' details, class of shares, and voting rights attached
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include nominee disclosures; executed nominee declarations must be maintained in the corporate register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital (class, par value, number of shares)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital applies; record the precise memorandum figures and any share premium.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compliance declaration confirming no domestic Vanuatu business, no prohibited activity, and no sanctions exposure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Material misstatement is a criminal offence; certify that the Virtual CFO services are rendered exclusively to non-residents.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers graduated late fees under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations, potential administrative strike-off of the IC, and restoration costs before the VFSC. Knowingly false declarations constitute an offence under the International Companies Act punishable by fine and imprisonment of directors for up to 12 months.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return prescribed under the VAT Act [Cap 247] as amended by the VAT (Amendment) Act 2018; filed electronically through the official Vanuatu tax authority portal (vanuatu.gov.vu VAT module).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (standard registrants); monthly where the Commissioner directs
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and full payment due on or before the 21st day of the month following the end of the VAT period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total output tax on standard-rated local supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Virtual CFO services supplied to Vanuatu residents are taxable at 12.5%; services delivered and consumed abroad are outside the domestic VAT base.
Retain foreign client contracts, Stripe and Wise settlement records, service engagement logs, and jurisdiction of the customer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credit claimed on imported procurement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only where a valid VAT invoice exists and the cost supports taxable or zero-rated output; apportion mixed-use expenses.
A pure offshore Virtual CFO operation should show continuous refund or nil-payable positions; maintain a multicurrency ledger reconciling each VAT period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment penalties accrue under the VAT Act, including monthly surcharges on unpaid VAT, evasion fines payable per offence, and imprisonment up to 24 months for deliberate tax evasion; officers who cause defaults bear joint liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no tax on outbound distributions to shareholders)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreements are currently in force for Vanuatu. An International Company does not file domestic income tax returns and cannot obtain an income-tax residence certificate because Vanuatu levies no income tax. To evidence tax status to foreign counterparties and tax authorities, the entity should obtain: (1) the Certificate of Incorporation; (2) a current Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC; (3) a certified extract of the IC Act Section 75 tax exemption; and (4) a notarized corporate status and beneficial ownership letter from the licensed registered agent. Dividend payments from the IC to non-resident shareholders are paid free of Vanuatu tax; foreign shareholders remain subject to their own tax on dividends where applicable.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on cross-border royalties, debt interest, management fees, and service fees. Treaty rates: none available. Anti-avoidance caveat: foreign taxing authorities may recharacterize royalty or interest payments under controlled foreign corporation and profit-shifting rules where the IC lacks genuine economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing regime, Local File, Master File, or contemporaneous documentation obligation exists in Vanuatu. Practical OECD-aligned risk benchmarks for the Virtual CFO structure: prepare a Local File where related-party service revenue exceeds approximately VUV 400 million (circa EUR 3 million) and a Master File where group revenue exceeds approximately VUV 1.5 billion (circa EUR 12 million). Even below these thresholds, maintain a basic arm's length evidence file when the Vanuatu IC invoices related controlled entities abroad, in order to preempt foreign audit adjustments.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations comparable to UAE standards. However, the International Companies Act prohibits carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, and VFSC AML Rules require a beneficial ownership and economic purpose file. Foreign CFC, permanent establishment, and substance-over-form doctrines will disregard the IC if strategic management, employees, client contracting, and multicurrency ledger operations are performed abroad. The Virtual CFO IC should evidence board meetings, client contracts, invoice trails via Stripe and Wise, and substantive bookkeeping output in Vanuatu or a recognized offshore back-office to survive judicial scrutiny.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as a mere invoicing conduit to conceal onshore taxable revenue, including backdated agreements, mirror invoices, or round-tripping of funds related to the purported CFO advisory services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign criminal tax penalties, civil fraud penalties up to 200% of the unpaid tax, restitution orders, and imprisonment under cross-border evasion statutes. Vanuatu cooperates through the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance and the FATCA IGA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution, worldwide asset freezing, travel bans, extradition risk, and imprisonment in the prosecuting jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Trading with Vanuatu residents / domestic market violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing and delivering virtual CFO or accounting services to Vanuatu domestic clients, employing local staff, or leasing local premises beyond the statutory international scope of the IC license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the International Companies Act: fines, daily default penalties, cease-and-desist orders, and strike-off of the IC from the VFSC register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally fined, disqualified from management in Vanuatu, and barred from serving in any VFSC-regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Zero employees, near-zero operating expenditure, generic memorandum, and invoice issuance without substantive service delivery logs, produced exclusively to shield profits from foreign tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign courts and tax agencies may reattribute the IC's profits to shareholders, impose CFC tax, deny treaty-like benefits, and treat the entity as void for fiscal purposes; VFSC may also audit and withhold certificates of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director-level exposure in foreign discovery proceedings, joint asset-tracing orders, contribution orders in settlement agreements, and travel restrictions imposed by foreign courts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file beneficial ownership declarations with the registered agent, omission of CRS self-certifications, nominee opacity, or accepting payments through unverified channels inconsistent with the declared low-risk standard.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC AML Rules enforcement: administrative monetary penalties as prescribed by law, suspension or revocation of the registered agent, mandatory BO filing corrections, and foreign bank de-risking caused by FATF grey-list scrutiny of Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Management liability for AML breaches, travel bans in aggravated cross-border cases, disqualification as responsible persons, and personal fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Signing the Box 8 compliance declaration knowing that the IC is conducting prohibited domestic business, concealing sanctions exposure, or misrepresenting shareholder identity in the VFSC register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offence under the International Companies Act: fine per offence, imprisonment of directors up to 12 months, and discretionary strike-off of the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment, personal restitution of fees and costs, and a ban on holding any directorship in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Continuing to trade while VAT liabilities, agent fees, and subcontractor obligations exceed realizable assets, or issuing balance sheets for foreign users that misstate the IC's liabilities and multicurrency exposures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu insolvency and fraudulent trading rules impose civil liability for company debts, criminal penalties, and up to 2 years imprisonment for dishonest trading.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution for debts incurred dishonestly, personal bankruptcy orders, travel bans, and disqualification orders.
